content.value: Trus members supporting a roof are connected to a 26 mm thick gusset plate by a 22 mm diameter pin as shown in the figure. The two end plates on the truss members are each 14 mm thick.
(i) Determine the average bearing stress between the end plates and the pin, and also between the gusset plate and the pin.
(ii) If the ultimate shear stress for the pin is 190 MPa, what force P is required to cause the pin to fail in shear?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
